reports.title: Statistics Act (통계법)
reports.description: Framework law governing the production, dissemination and use of official statistics in the Republic of Korea. Wholly amended in 2007 (Act No. 8387) and subsequently revised. Establishes the purpose of statistics as a public resource for rational decision-making, requires scientific methods to ensure accuracy, timeliness, consistency and impartiality, and provides the legal basis for designated statistics, statistical agencies and coordination by the Commissioner of Statistics Korea.
reports._notes: Foundational legal node, parallel to Japan’s Statistics Act 2007. Continuously cited as the authority for the reliability and coordination of official statistics. Qualifies under the expanded definition as a static instrument that is recurringly referenced in the operation of the entire statistical system.
_referenced_by: KOSTAT methodological documents and designation of official statistics
KOSIS portal and official statistical programmes
International assessments of Korea’s statistical system (IMF SDDS, OECD, UN)

reports.title: Statistics Korea (KOSTAT) — national statistical office
reports.description: Central government agency responsible for producing, coordinating and disseminating official statistics. Operates the KOSIS (Korean Statistical Information Service) portal, conducts major censuses and surveys, and designates official statistics under the Statistics Act.
reports._notes: Institutional node. KOSTAT is the primary producer of demographic, labour, price, household and many economic statistics and the coordinator of the national statistical system.

The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. reports.title: Producer Price Index (생산자물가지수)
reports.description: Monthly index of prices received by domestic producers for their output. Complements the CPI as the main producer-side inflation measure.

reports.description: Monthly and annual customs-based merchandise trade statistics by commodity, partner country, and enterprise characteristics. Primary source for Korea’s export and import performance, including the high concentration in semiconductors and other key items.

reports.title: National Greenhouse Gas Inventory (국가 온실가스 인벤토리)
reports.publisher: Greenhouse Gas Inventory and Research Center of Korea (GIR) / Ministry of Environment
reports.description: Official annual national greenhouse-gas inventory compiled according to IPCC guidelines. Reports total emissions, sectoral breakdowns (energy, industrial processes, agriculture, LULUCF, waste) and is the empirical basis for NDC tracking and climate-policy evaluation.
reports._notes: Core environmental statistics node. Continuously cited in climate policy, energy-transition analysis and international reporting under the Paris Agreement. Complements the energy-balance and electricity-generation (including nuclear) series.

reports.title: Financial Stability Report and related BOK financial-system statistics
reports.description: Periodic Financial Stability Report together with underlying statistics on household debt, corporate credit, bank soundness, non-bank financial institutions and systemic-risk indicators.
reports._notes: Deepens the financial cluster beyond monetary aggregates and Flow of Funds. Household debt and real-estate-linked leverage are major structural issues in Korea; these reports and statistics are continuously cited in macro-prudential and housing-policy analysis.

reports.title: External debt and foreign-reserve statistics
reports.publisher: Bank of Korea (BOK) / Ministry of Economy and Finance
reports.description: Statistics on gross and net external debt by sector and maturity, together with official foreign-exchange reserve holdings and related external-vulnerability indicators.
